name: jev
description: Jev picks the tool that fits Claude's next step and Claude gets it as a hint, shown live and measured against a control group. Native to Claude Code: no gateway, no proxy.

mode.title: Jev: hints
mode.description: on: Jev is asked before Claude's requests and Claude gets its confident picks as a hint. shadow: Jev is asked and its picks are recorded, but nothing reaches Claude. off: Jev is never asked.

controlPercent.title: Jev: control group (%)
controlPercent.description: With hints on, this share of turns runs without Jev, so the /jev pane can compare hints with no hints on your own work. 0 turns it off.

doneCheck.title: Jev: done check
doneCheck.description: When Claude stops after promising more work, with nothing running and nothing asked of you, Jev catches it. shadow: recorded in /jev only. on: Claude is sent back to work (once per turn). off: never checked.

effort.title: Jev: effort
effort.description: on: quick status questions (is it deployed, are we done) run at low effort, on the same model, back to your effort if the turn grows. shadow: recorded only. off: your effort always.

skillGate.title: Jev: skill gate
skillGate.description: on: at session start Jev judges which skills this project needs; the others keep only their name in the list Claude reads on every request (still callable). shadow: recorded only. off: the full list.

freshStart.title: Jev: fresh start
freshStart.description: ask: when a prompt starts a new task that needs nothing from a long conversation, Jev offers /clear or /compact before sending it. off: never asks.

excludedRepos.title: Jev: excluded repos
excludedRepos.description: Comma-separated folder names. Sessions in these folders never ask Jev, so their conversations are not sent to it, and their prompts stay out of the log.
